## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔄 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## ✅ Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## 📱 Environment
**Device Information:**
- Device: [e.g. iPhone 12, Desktop]
- OS: [e.g. iOS 15.0, Windows 11, macOS 12.0]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 98, Safari 15, Firefox 95]
- Screen Resolution: [e.g. 1920x1080, 375x812]

**Application Environment:**
- Environment: [Production/Staging/Development]
- URL: [where the bug occurred]
- User Type: [Guest/Logged in/Admin]
- Account: [if applicable, user email or ID]

## 📸 Screenshots/Video
If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain your problem.

## 🔍 Console Errors
If applicable, paste any console errors (press F12 → Console):
```
Paste console errors here
```

## 🌐 Network Information
- [ ] Error occurs on Wi-Fi
- [ ] Error occurs on Mobile Data
- [ ] Error occurs offline
- [ ] Error is intermittent

## 💳 Payment Related (if applicable)
- [ ] Cart/Checkout issue
- [ ] Payment gateway error
- [ ] Order processing issue
- [ ] Razorpay related
- Payment Method: [Card/UPI/COD/Wallet]

## 🎮 Game Related (if applicable)
- [ ] Runner game not loading
- [ ] Score not saving
- [ ] Leaderboard issue
- [ ] Rewards not working
- Game Version: [if known]

## 📊 Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here.

## 🚨 Impact Level
- [ ] Critical (Blocks main functionality)
- [ ] High (Significantly impacts user experience)
- [ ] Medium (Minor functionality affected)
- [ ] Low (Cosmetic or enhancement)

## 🔧 Possible Solution
If you have suggestions on how to fix the bug, please describe them here.

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided all necessary information to reproduce the bug
- [ ] I have tested this on multiple browsers/devices (if possible)
- [ ] I have checked the browser console for errors
